# Decorators

Decorators register callback functions on a client and create the matching handler for you. They are the concise option for most applications.

## Example

```python
from pyrogram import Client, filters

app = Client("my_account")

@app.on_message(filters.private)
async def on_private_message(client, message):
    await message.reply("Hello")

app.run()
```
